name: Bramblegrown Owlbear

Actions.name: Talons
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 17 (3d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Thorned Embrace
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 14, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14).
Actions.clause: When the bramblegrown owlbear hits with a melee attack, thorn-barbed tendrils burst up through its hide and lash around
Actions.expresses: bramble growths erupting through hide and flesh

lore: A beast born when an owlbear's carcass fell into a bramble-choked hollow, the thorns growing up through it instead of around it, now guarding that same hollow against anything that moves and breathes.

generation.userConcept: a thing like an owlbear but grown through with brambles
generation.cite: composition after Ogre (CR 2) — one colossal hit, no traits

monsterDescription: a thing like an owlbear but grown through with brambles
